int_name: N MARSHALL ST & W SUSQUEHANNA AVE

result.summary: The image shows a residential and commercial intersection lacking basic traffic control and marked pedestrian crossings. While sidewalks and a modern curb ramp with tactile warnings are present, the absence of stop signs or crosswalk markings creates an uncontrolled environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks, which fails to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible at the intersection, creating an uncontrolled conflict point between vehicles and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners may block the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left curbs near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: All-Way Stop Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs to regulate traffic flow and provide predictable crossing opportunities.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a wide one-way street with sidewalks but no marked crossings or traffic control devices. The industrial setting and presence of large parked vehicles create significant crossing distances and sightline obstructions.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large truck parked on the right side of the road obscures visibility for pedestrians and approaching drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian crossing locations.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at potential crossing points to reduce the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near intersections to ensure clear sightlines between all road users.

result.summary: The environment is a low-density urban intersection lacking basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or traffic control signs. Sidewalks are present but obstructed by debris, and parked vehicles near the corner significantly limit visibility for both drivers and pedestrians.
